_readme: Your chatbot. Same shape as the platform's seed/TEMPLATE.json, so a business can move between repos.
bot_id: 2-63 chars, lowercase letters/digits/hyphens. Fixed at onboarding — it is the chat URL and widget id.

settings: only these keys are accepted: tone, system_rules, fallback_message, greeting, brand_color, lead_capture, handoff_email, retrieval_floor, min_context_chars, closed_book, always_include_titles.
items: keep every item UNDER 1200 chars. Start content with a Q-line listing every phrasing a visitor might use, blank line, then 'A: ...'.
items: title is the unique key — never rename a live item; add a new one instead. Sync only ADDS items by title; to change live text, ask Easy Cloud.
eval: one [question, expected item title] per Q-line phrasing, in the same commit as the item. CI fails the push if any question misses.
Never put prices or promises in system_rules or items that you have not confirmed in writing.
name: Acme Plumbing Assistant

settings.system_rules: Answer only from the provided context. If unsure, say so and offer the phone number.
settings.fallback_message: I don't have that information, but the team can help — call (555) 010-0100 or use the contact form.
settings.greeting: Hi! Ask me about our services, hours, or how to book a visit.

items.title: What does Acme Plumbing do?
items.content:
Q: What do you do? What services do you offer? Do you do drain cleaning? Do you handle water heaters?

A: Acme Plumbing is a licensed residential plumber serving the South Bay. We handle drain cleaning, water heater repair and replacement, leak detection, and fixture installs. Call (555) 010-0100 to book a visit.

items.title: Hours and service area
items.content:
Q: What are your hours? Are you open on weekends? Do you serve Torrance? What areas do you cover?

A: We take calls Monday to Saturday, 7am to 6pm, and offer emergency service after hours. We serve Torrance, Redondo Beach, Gardena, and the surrounding South Bay.
